role: Split out of ReanalysisService.swift: RescoreWrite, the optimistic write a rescore uses to reach the archive — under SessionArchive.update it compares the stored copy's inputs with the copy the rescore read and, when they match, sets only the fields that kind of rescore computes; when they differ it writes nothing and the caller reruns from the stored copy.
types: RescoreWrite: enum (file scope, nonisolated) — the optimistic rescore write: Kind, Outcome, the input comparison and the per-kind computed fields
RescoreWrite.Inputs: struct (private, Encodable) — what a rescore is computed from
state: RescoreWrite.runs (static let = 3); RescoreWrite.computedFields / storedFields: Set<String> — every stored HRVSession field, classified
toplevel: File-scope enum, not actor-isolated; ReanalysisService (rescore and score-only paths) and SessionAcceptanceService.reArchive use it.

units.does: The written session for .written; nil for .inputsChanged.

Writes a rescore computed from `read` onto the archived copy. A rescore never creates a session: when the archive does not hold the id (never archived, or deleted or purged while it ran) logs and returns .notArchived with nothing written. Otherwise inside SessionArchive.updateIfChanged (requestingReupload false): when the stored copy's inputs differ from the read copy's (inputsMatch) returns .inputsChanged with the stored copy and writes nothing; else sets only this kind's computed fields on the stored copy (applyComputedFields) and returns .written with it. Throws what the archive throws (PurgeGate.Refused while Delete All My Data runs).

Sets recoveryScore, scoreBreakdown and frozenReadiness from the rescored session. Reanalysis also sets analysisResult, artifactFlags, windowUserAdjusted and hrvDataQuality, and trainingSnapshot only when healed. Score-only sets trainingSnapshot and analysisResult.trainingContext only when healed, and nothing else.

branches.effect: reanalysis: the window fields; scoreOnly: only the healed training

units.does: For a reanalysis whose inputs changed: nil (logged) when the stored copy has a manual window the read copy had not, when this was the last run, or when the stored copy has no beats; otherwise the stored copy to run again from.
True when the training context's ATL or CTL differs from the candidate's (or there is no candidate).
Compares the two copies' encoded inputs for this kind (encodedInputs); false when either cannot be encoded.
JSON-encodes the session's Inputs with sorted keys (non-finite numbers as strings); nil and a warning log when encoding throws.

Captures what a rescore is computed from: beat count and first/last t_ms, sleepStartMs/EndMs, sleepSegments, sleepSnapshot, vitalsSnapshot, perceivedReadiness, trainingSnapshot; for a reanalysis also windowUserAdjusted, for a score-only pass also analysisResult.
